caption: Questions that remain open before a hire decision. Known facts cite official or owner sources. Unknowns stay blank rather than inferred. Each row names how to obtain the missing fact.

rows.question: Can the stuck trip lever be freed or replaced from the tub side without opening a wall or ceiling?
rows.known: Owner reports five or more licensed plumbers could not free it from above. Manufacturer trip-lever instructions describe some service from the overflow plate.
rows.unknown: Brand/model, linkage condition, overflow-elbow access, and whether a current plumber can extract it from the tub side.
rows.how_to_discover: Photograph the overflow plate, screws and visible linkage. Ask Ace, then Heise’s, then Rapid Flow to attempt a tub-side diagnosis first and to write the result before any ceiling cut.

rows.question: If tub-side service fails, is the storage-unit ceiling the correct and lawful access path?
rows.known: Owner prefers below-ceiling access through the storage unit if tub-side service fails. Heise’s published an Ingleside ceiling-access waste-and-overflow replacement.
rows.unknown: Ceiling construction, existing access panel, fire rating, and who controls the storage unit.
rows.how_to_discover: Have the hired plumber inspect from below, measure any existing opening, and state in writing whether the ceiling must be opened.

rows.question: Is the storage-unit ceiling part of a fire-resistive assembly?
rows.known: SFBC §106A.2(10) exempts minor interior plaster or wallboard repair except when it is part of a fire-resistive assembly. Any fire rating must be restored.
rows.unknown: Whether this ceiling is Type X gypsum or otherwise fire-rated.
rows.how_to_discover: Ask the contractor and DBI, in writing, before any cut. Do not assume a minor-repair exemption.

rows.question: Does this exact scope require a plumbing permit and inspection before covering?
rows.known: SF.gov requires a permit before cutting into or replacing pipes, particularly pipes that will be covered by a wall. 2025 SFPC §104.2 exemptions are conditional. City offices are closed Wednesday 2026-11-11 for Veterans Day.
rows.unknown: Whether this stuck-lever job matches an exemption, which fee category applies, and whether online PermitSF filing is available during the closure.
rows.how_to_discover: Ask the contractor for a written permit position. For an in-person DBI determination, the next business day is Thursday 2026-11-12. Help desk 628-652-4900; do not infer an online outage.

rows.question: Who will perform the drywall patch, texture and paint, and under what license?
rows.known: BPC §7059(a) and 16 CCR §831 limit specialty contractors to incidental, supplemental and essential other-trade work. Ace, Rapid Flow, Ayoob & Peery, We Do, Save-On-Interior and D G hold B + C-36. Bernal Hill and Amador’s Drywall hold C-9 + B. Heise’s advertises patching but has no B or C-9.
rows.unknown: Whether any lead will self-perform, subcontract, or document incidental-and-essential status for this ceiling.
rows.how_to_discover: Require every written quote to name the restoration party and license number, or to document the BPC §7059(a)/16 CCR §831 rationale.

rows.question: What is the current written price for the two-path scope, with ceiling restoration as its own line?
rows.known: Owner-reported 2026-08-30 amounts: Expert $614 (replace waste and overflow), Bay Area $550 (lever/plug/spout with diverter), Fast Response $135 (repair/adjust plunger handle). Verified amounts are blank. Official DBI Category 1P is $290 if that category applies.
rows.unknown: Any current combined plumbing-plus-restoration price. None of the supplied scopes names ceiling opening or finish work.
rows.how_to_discover: Send the copy-ready request on the dashboard to Ace, Heise’s and Rapid Flow. Do not add permit fees to a quote until the quote says whether they are included.

rows.question: Have Civil Code §1954 notice and storage-unit authority been arranged?
rows.known: Civil Code §1954 requires notice before entry of a dwelling. The unit is tenant-occupied. The overflow plumbing is described as behind the wall with possible access through a storage-unit ceiling.
rows.unknown: Whether the storage unit is part of the same tenancy, a different tenancy, or common area, and whether notice has already been given.
rows.how_to_discover: Confirm storage-unit control in writing. Give required notice before any entry. Coordinate water shut-off and contents protection.

rows.question: Does finish disturbance require lead-safe or asbestos screening?
rows.known: EPA RRP applies to paid renovation disturbing painted surfaces in pre-1978 housing. EPA asbestos rules apply when suspect materials are disturbed.
rows.unknown: Building age, paint condition, and whether the ceiling contains asbestos-containing material.
rows.how_to_discover: Check the Assessor record for year built. Ask the contractor to screen before cutting. Do not disturb finishes until that answer is written.

rows.question: What waste-and-overflow assembly is installed?
rows.known: The overflow is a trip-lever type. Watco 500/501/600TL instructions are the manufacturer reference used in this dossier; they are not proof of the installed brand.
rows.unknown: Brand, model, tub thickness, linkage length, and left/right outlet.
rows.how_to_discover: Photograph the overflow plate, trip lever and drain flange, including any markings, and send them with the quote request.

rows.question: Which ranked lead can actually take this occupied-unit job, and when?
rows.known: No provider has been contacted, booked or paid. Ace, Heise’s and Rapid Flow are the first three inquiry leads. City offices are closed 2026-11-11.
rows.unknown: Current dispatch capacity, occupied-unit protocol, and earliest lawful start after tenant notice.
rows.how_to_discover: Call Ace (415) 824-6444 first, then Heise’s (415) 333-0704, then Rapid Flow (415) 866-8401 using the numbers on the CSLB records. Ask for a written date that respects Civil Code §1954.

rows.question: Will Fast Response’s workers-compensation policy still be current if that lead is used?
rows.known: CSLB #1024971 shows a workers-compensation policy expiring 12/18/2026, reconfirmed 2026-11-11.
rows.unknown: Whether a renewal will be on file by any later work date.
rows.how_to_discover: Recheck the CSLB license detail on the work day. Prefer a lead with a longer-dated policy if the date is close.

rows.question: Which legal name and license number go on the contract?
rows.known: Heise’s active license is #1089561 TARO GROUP INC dba HEISES PLUMBING. Prior entity #787733 expired and was dissolved. Ace is #829071 ACE PLUMBING & ROOTER. Rapid Flow is #1115649 RAPID FLOW PLUMBING & ROOTER INC. Eric Brand #920294 is canceled.
rows.unknown: The entity that will actually sign, and whether any dba on a quote matches the active CSLB record.
rows.how_to_discover: Match the contract name and number to the CSLB license detail on signing day. Do not accept a canceled or dissolved entity.

rows.question: If a separate C-9 specialist is needed, which restoration firm is asked for the ceiling half?
rows.known: Bernal Hill Drywall #995163 (C-9 + B, San Francisco, (415) 533-8274) is the primary restoration partner. Amador’s Drywall #1031231 (C-9 + B, South San Francisco) is a second CSLB-checked option; CSLB phone (415) 756-4958 differs from the company contact page (628) 529-7248.
rows.unknown: Whether either firm will work under the plumber or under the owner, opening size, finish match, and price.
rows.how_to_discover: Ask Bernal Hill first for a patch-texture-paint quote conditional on a defined opening. If a second bid is wanted, confirm Amador’s dispatch number in writing, then request the same scope.

rows.question: Can Portola Plumbing Services be identified on the official license board?
rows.known: Yelp search excerpts continue to name Portola for bathtub work. No CSLB license number, phone or status could be matched.
rows.unknown: Legal name, license number, status, classifications and phone.
rows.how_to_discover: Do not hire from the listing. If a card or invoice appears later, look the number up on the CSLB Check a License page before any payment.
